title: Car Buzz, Squeak and Rattle Noise Testing
seoDescription: GRAS microphones for buzz, squeak and rattle noise testing of vehicles, including electric vehicles where low masking makes BSR more noticeable.

props.title: Car Buzz, Squeak and Rattle Noise Testing
paragraphs: Buzz, squeak and rattle (BSR) are noises made by installed parts that move against each other, sometimes only in certain environmental conditions. Buzz comes from the structure or part itself, squeak from friction between parts and rattle from impact.

Even at low levels BSR is easy to hear because it is intermittent and poorly masked, and it is a common source of customer complaints. In electric vehicles masking is lower still while weight targets make BSR harder to prevent.

image.alt: Car Buzz, Squeak and Rattle Noise Testing

props.body:
- Chassis and structural design, material selection and controlled tolerance chains are specified in the design targets, from prototype to production
- Measure continuously with reliable measurement microphones
- BSR testing uses microphones and vibration sensors to locate the noise source and improve perceived quality
